name: vnstock-sim
description: VNCoin: sàn giao dịch coin Spot mô phỏng (paper trading) với giá thật từ Binance

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:mobile: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev:lan -w frontend"
scripts.start: cd backend && FRONTEND_DIST=../frontend/dist node --import tsx src/index.ts
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
